notes: Metres, Z up, robot front -X, shared bottom-centre frame; applied transforms. CPU Cycles 64 diffuse colour times mix(1, AO, 0.6); PBR source retained. Inspection render 1024 square; preview thumbnail 512 for the unchanged validator. The card front uses the complete [0,1] UV rectangle, with no packing or margins. Native replacement artwork is 1480 x 1050. The unchanged validator only accepts square 1024/2048 part textures; the default card_albedo is a square bake of that artwork, geometrically restored to A6 by the full-face UVs. Acrylic is an untextured rgba part. Card is a closed 0.3 mm paper slab backed by real acrylic; support and card share one convex collision. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Hidden card back/edge UVs sample the white lower-left pixel; front UV area remains exactly one. The closed 0.3 mm slab supports simulator mesh import.
preview_source: Delivered OBJ meshes and exported albedos; 1024 native inspection, 512 thumbnail.
